pages.text: Sneak with equipment in your main hand and right-click a smithing table. Ordinary ascension still uses the three smithing slots. Reinforcement has fixed costs and caps at+5, preserving names, enchantments and damage.

Each level adds10 percent maximum durability. Total equipped reinforcement lowers ordinary skill costs by up to20 percent; domains are not discounted. LevelN costs2^N star ingots,2N diamonds and5N XP levels. Levels4 and5 each also cost1 singularity. +2 waves pierce2 targets; +4 waves pierce3.$(br2)reinforcement.enabled / reinforcement.maxLevel
